name: Amazon Marketing Cloud
shortInfo: AMC provides advertisers with campaign, audience & media analysis
brief: Amazon Marketing Cloud is a secure, privacy-safe, and cloud-based clean room solution, in which advertisers can easily perform analytics across pseudonymized signals, including Amazon Ads signals as well as their own inputs
about:
Amazon Marketing Cloud is a holistic measurement solution that helps advertisers perform custom analytics and generate cross-media insights.  
  
Learn more about [Amazon Marketing Cloud API documentation.](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/amazon-marketing-cloud)
availableData:
[Query](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_storage/amazon-marketing-cloud/pipelines/query.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve data from the Amazon Marketing Cloud into a data warehouse of your choice with the granularity of a Query result you desire.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-marketing-cloud/index.html) here.
